dict.string: Joris Apple Toolbox uses your location to inspect live Core Location updates.
Joris Apple Toolbox asks for Always access only when you choose to test visit and significant-change monitoring.
Precise location shows your exact position and lets the Core Location experiment monitor a small region around you.
Joris Apple Toolbox reads steps, distance, floors and barometric altitude for the Core Motion experiment.
Joris Apple Toolbox uses Face ID for the LocalAuthentication, Keychain and Secure Enclave experiments.
Joris Apple Toolbox requests Apple Music access for the MusicKit experiment.
Joris Apple Toolbox measures distance and direction to a nearby device for the Nearby Interaction experiment.
Joris Apple Toolbox reads nearby NFC tags, and writes a tag only when you choose to, for the NFC experiments.
Joris Apple Toolbox uses Bluetooth to scan for, connect to and advertise to nearby Bluetooth LE devices and to pair Bluetooth MIDI devices in the Bluetooth experiments.
Joris Apple Toolbox uses the camera for the Camera and Vision, ARKit and RoomPlan experiments.
Joris Apple Toolbox uses the microphone for the Audio Input, Speech Recognition, Sound Analysis and ShazamKit experiments.
Joris Apple Toolbox uses speech recognition for the Speech experiment.
Joris Apple Toolbox discovers homes and accessories for the HomeKit experiment.
Joris Apple Toolbox reads step count only when you explicitly authorize the HealthKit experiment.
Joris Apple Toolbox discovers nearby devices and local network services for the MultipeerConnectivity experiment and the Network Inspector, and runs the inspector's echo listener.
